persona.temperament: Ice-cold and selfish in the box
persona.backstory: Street-football king of Surulere who has never passed in the final third and never apologised for it.
Watched a decade of goals frame by frame and now arrives where the ball will be before anyone else knows.

persona.temperament: Calm; sees the pitch from above
persona.backstory: Started as a full-back; a coach moved him inside after noticing he talked more than he ran, and was right.
Grew up in his father's café counting the beats of a restaurant rush. Plays the same way.
Split his youth between Enugu and Malmö and learned to defend in both snow and dust.

persona.temperament: Showman who lives for the crowd
persona.backstory: Kano's most-filmed teenager; his skill videos had more views than his club's matches.

persona.weapon: Long throw to start the counter
persona.backstory: A failed striker who went in goal for one match and never came back out.
Ran 10km to training every day for three years because the bus fare went on boots.
Rosario sprint champion at 14 who picked football because track had no crowds.
Raised on judo before football; still wins the ball like he is throwing someone.

persona.temperament: Gentle giant until the ball is in the air
persona.backstory: Lagos beach-football legend who learned to control any ball on sand, so grass is easy.
Futsal-trained in São Paulo; would rather risk a pass than clear it.
Kumasi-born, Leeds-raised, still argues about which city taught him more.
Abuja's quiet kid who scores from positions nobody marks because nobody notices him.

persona.weapon: Pressing trigger that wins it high
persona.backstory: Gaelic football convert from Cork who tackles like the ball owes him money.
Saved seven penalties in a single youth tournament and has been smiling since.
